summary: Iteration 5 backend regression (5/5 pytest) is now repeatable with dynamic-date + cleanup fixture. All new admin CRUD endpoints (chairs, users, settings) and DELETE /api/bookings/{id} work. Frontend Live-Activity nav, AdminPanel three tabs, chair/user/settings CRUD, role-gated admin nav, session persistence, and logout all work. CRITICAL regression: WebSocket real-time propagation across two clients is broken because the /ws route is not under /api, so the ingress does not proxy it to the backend (no WS connections logged; browser reports 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'). All two-page create/status/cancel updates require manual refresh.

critical.issue: Route registered as app.websocket('/ws') but the K8s ingress only routes /api/* to backend, so WebSocket handshake never reaches FastAPI. Backend logs show zero WS traffic. Move endpoint to /api/ws (and update WS_URL in App.js to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/ws`).

integration_issues.issue: Bookings created/updated/cancelled in client A do not appear in client B without a manual refresh because the WS at wss://<host>/ws fails to connect. Once /ws is moved under /api/ws (and WS_URL updated), propagation should work.

action_items: Move backend WebSocket route from @app.websocket('/ws') to @app.websocket('/api/ws') (or add a mirror) so it is reachable through the ingress, and update WS_URL in /app/frontend/src/App.js to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.replace(/^http/, 'ws')}/api/ws`.
After the fix, re-run the two-client propagation test (create/update/cancel) to confirm client B updates within ~2s without refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: WebSocket endpoint is outside the /api prefix; every other public route uses APIRouter(prefix='/api'). The mismatch breaks ingress routing in this environment.
server.py: broadcast() serially awaits every socket; a slow client will delay events for all. Consider asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True.
Board.jsx and ActivityView.jsx open independent WebSocket connections; consolidating in a context provider would prevent duplicate opens on remount.
ActivityView.jsx: the auth object is recreated each render but useCallback deps only track [date], which is fine, but eslint-react-hooks would flag it.
SettingsAdmin: after changing slot_interval, other clients only see the new grid on next load; the change is not broadcast (would benefit from a settings_changed WS event).
Frontend uses localStorage for session token while backend also sets an httpOnly cookie; two auth mechanisms in parallel work but are duplicative — pick one.

success_rate.frontend: ≈92% (all single-client flows pass; two-client WS propagation fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite (5 tests) is stable and re-runnable. Admin panel + activity view UI fully works. Only outstanding item: the /ws endpoint is unreachable through the preview ingress; once moved under /api the two-client propagation flow (create -> arrived -> cancel) needs to be re-verified. Playwright's page.on('websocket') was used to confirm attempts, and backend logs showed no WS entries at all, confirming the ingress does not proxy /ws.
rca of the issue: FastAPI declares @app.websocket('/ws'). The Kubernetes ingress in this preview environment only forwards paths beginning with /api to the backend service on port 8001; anything else (including /ws) is served by the frontend origin, which cannot upgrade to a WebSocket. As a result the browser sees 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established', the connections set on the backend stays empty, and broadcast() sends to nobody. Mitigation: register the endpoint at /api/ws and update WS_URL in App.js to match. Two-client real-time sync will then work as designed.
